_comment: Port allocation registry for multi-agent development. This file is the SOLE authority for port allocation - workspace CLAUDE.md tables and .env.clone files are both generated from it plus the clone's own path, and never hand-maintained. Each repo gets a block of 16 ports per service type. The entries below are EXAMPLES showing the schema - replace them with your own repos. Keep each repo's base ports at least 16 apart so blocks do not overlap.
_formula: offset = workspace * clones_per_workspace + clone (workspace model) or clone_number (flat model); port = base_port + offset
_derivation: Never hand-edit .env.clone. Run: python3 ~/.claude/lib/clone_identity.py audit | repair [--all]
_clones_per_workspace_note: Optional per-repo, default 4. Set it when a repo's workspaces hold a different number of clones - inferring it by counting sibling directories is unstable, because one stray or missing directory would silently shift every port in the workspace.

example-monorepo.notes: Frontend + worker + extra docs port; 3 clones per workspace (example entry)
